## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) spots a dressed-up [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in his buggy, sparking her intense curiosity. She visits [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate and learns that the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) are adopting an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), a decision Mrs. Rachel strongly disapproves of and warns [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) against.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, observing her new pupils and forming a quick bond with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) while struggling with [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md). After school, Mrs. H. B. Donnell confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over the pronunciation of her family's name and her son's name. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home feeling relieved after [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) gives her flowers, and she later discusses the day with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly proves to be a handful, getting into trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church and pumping water over [Dora](../character/dora.md) after coaxing her into a pigpen. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to gently guide [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) while removing a toad he hid in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from school enjoying the autumn day until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses he trapped her there and lied about it, but breaks down when he realizes lying is wrong, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to punish and educate him.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her experiences teaching at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, sharing funny student remarks and compositions. She recounts how [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) admitted to copying love letters for her assignment and highlights a imaginative letter written by her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

> After [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) passes away, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to live with her. This arrangement would free [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to resign from her teaching position and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in the fall.
>
